system: ENCHANTING MINIGAME (Spirit Wheel) — adornments discipline: gambling wheel minigame + enchantment application pipeline
summary: Enchanting is the one discipline whose minigame is a pure gambling game with no dexterity input: a 20-slice spinning wheel (green/red/grey), 3 spins, starting 100 "Essence" currency. Player bets each spin via slider/quick-bet buttons; slice colors map to per-spin payout multipliers. Final currency vs the starting 100 becomes an efficacy modifier (clamped ±50%) and a performance score (currency/200). The minigame ALWAYS reports success; efficacy can simply be negative. Difficulty (from material tier points × diversity) only shifts the wheel's green/red slice counts; later spins get progressively worse wheels (-1 green/+1 red per spin index). On completion the engine consumes 100% of recipe materials, awards XP, and either (a) calls EquipmentItem.apply_enchantment on a pre-selected target item (duplicate/tier-family/conflictsWith rules), or (b) adds a new enchanted-accessory item to inventory when no target was selected. Three minigame classes live in enchanting.py but only SpinningWheelMinigame is ever instantiated — PatternMatchingMinigame and freeform EnchantingMinigame are dead code. Several computed values (efficacy-scaled bonus_magnitude, buff/title bonuses, difficulty-interpolated payout multipliers) are computed but never affect the applied effect — the recipe JSON `effect` dict is applied verbatim. Port these quirks as-is.
player_facing: Entry: enchanting recipes (identified by having enchantmentId instead of outputId) open an item-selection UI listing all compatible inventory + equipped items before the minigame starts (game_engine.py:6971-6976, 7117-7147; recipe_db.py:50-56)
Compatibility filter: each candidate item checked with can_apply_enchantment(outputId, applicableTo, effect); 'No compatible items found!' notification if none (game_engine.py:7120-7141)
After selecting a target item, the selection is stored and the wheel minigame starts; the target can also be None (accessory-creation path) (game_engine.py:7162-7176, 4266-4272)

Minigame window: 1000x700 'SPIRIT WHEEL' panel, right-aligned, light-blue spirit gradient + floating particle aesthetic; Essence (currency) panel left, 'Spin N / 3' counter right (game_engine.py:11169-11268)
Metadata overlay on open shows discipline, difficulty tier/points, 'Starting Currency', 'Spins: 3', and a display-only max_bonus = 1.0 + difficulty_points*0.025 (game_engine.py:11178-11190)

Betting phase UI: current bet display, drag slider (bet = int(sliderPos/sliderWidth * currentCurrency), min 1), quick-bet buttons $10/$25/$50/ALL (ALL = current currency), and 'CHANNEL SPIRITS' confirm button (game_engine.py:11404-11498, 2354-2380, 11452)
Payout panel always shows the CURRENT spin's three multipliers (GREEN/GREY/RED) so player sees odds before betting (game_engine.py:11350-11402)

Wheel visibility: visible on spin 1 from start; hidden as a pulsing '?' orb with hint 'Place bet to reveal the wheel' on spins 2-3 until the bet is confirmed (enchanting.py:211, 269, 348; game_engine.py:11335-11348)
ready_to_spin phase: shows 'Essence Wagered: N' + glowing 'SPIN THE WHEEL' button (game_engine.py:11500-11524)
spinning phase: pulsing 'CHANNELING...' text, no buttons; wheel animates 2s with ease-out deceleration, top pointer marks result slice (game_engine.py:11526-11533, 11320-11327; enchanting.py:226-249)
spin_result phase: panel 'Spirit landed on: COLOR' + signed profit; button 'CONTINUE' (spins 1-2) or 'COMPLETE RITUAL' (spin 3) (game_engine.py:11535-11574, 2389-2397)

completed phase: 'SPIRITS APPEASED' panel with Final Essence, Spirit Gift (currency diff), 'Enchantment Power: +/-X.X%', 'Click anywhere to continue'; clicking anywhere in the window finalizes the craft (game_engine.py:11576-11629, 2399-2407)

Success feedback: notification '<Rarity> <Name> applied to <item>! (Efficacy: +X.X%)' for target items, or 'Crafted <rarity> <name> x1' for accessories; enchant application also prints an 'ENCHANTMENT APPLIED' debug block (enchanting.py:1360, game_engine.py:9048-9099, equipment.py:304-308)

Minigame is REQUIRED for adornments — no skip/instant path in the minigame flow; materials are always consumed since the wheel always 'succeeds' (enchanting.py:7, 27, 398-399; game_engine.py:8970-8973)
mechanics: State machine phases: betting -> ready_to_spin -> spinning -> spin_result -> (betting for next spin | completed after spin 3) (enchanting.py:99, 268, 296, 326, 341-348, 354)
Constructor pre-generates all 3 wheels of 20 color strings each ('green'/'red'/'grey') using difficulty distribution (enchanting.py:101-102, 149-155)

Per-spin wheel worsening: green = max(3, base_green - spinNum), red = min(12, base_red + spinNum) for spinNum 0/1/2; if green+red > 17, overflow subtracted from green (floor 3); remainder grey; list shuffled (visual only — odds depend solely on counts) (enchanting.py:157-201)
Hardcoded payout multipliers per spin: spin1 {green 1.2, grey 1.0, red 0.66}; spin2 {green 1.5, grey 0.95, red 0.5}; spin3 {green 2.0, grey 0.8, red 0.0} (enchanting.py:90-94)
place_bet(amount): valid only in 'betting' phase, requires 0 < amount <= current_currency; sets phase 'ready_to_spin' and reveals wheel (enchanting.py:251-270)
spin_wheel(): valid only in 'ready_to_spin' with bet > 0; result slice = uniform random int 0..19; records wall-clock start time; phase 'spinning' (enchanting.py:272-297)

Spin animation: duration 2000 ms measured via time.time() (NOT the dt argument); ease-out cubic progress = 1-(1-p)^3; wheel_rotation = progress * (5*360 + sliceIndex*18 + 9) so pointer stops at slice center (18 deg per slice) (enchanting.py:226-249)

Result processing: winnings = int(bet * multiplier); profit = winnings - bet; currency = currency - bet + winnings; per-spin record appended {spin_number, bet, color, multiplier, winnings, profit, currency_after}; phase 'spin_result'; bet reset to 0 (enchanting.py:299-327)
advance_to_next_spin(): valid only in 'spin_result'; increments spin counter; after 3 spins calls complete(), otherwise phase 'betting' and hides wheel (enchanting.py:329-349)

PERFORMANCE FORMULA: currency_diff = final - 100; efficacy_percent = clamp((diff/100)*50, -50, +50); efficacy = efficacy_percent/100; performance = clamp(final_currency/200, 0, 1); if attempt == 1 add first_try_bonus('enchanting') = 0.10 to performance, cap 1.0 (enchanting.py:356-375; reward_calculator.py:52-74)
Result dict always success=True with efficacy, efficacy_percent, performance, final_currency, currency_diff, spin_results, difficulty_points, difficulty_tier, rewards (enchanting.py:398-410)

Rewards (calculate_enchanting_rewards): max_multiplier = 1.0 + normalized*1.5 where normalized = clamp((points-1)/(80-1)); base_performance = clamp(final/200); bonus_pct = int(perf * (max_mult-1) * 20); quality_tier via thresholds Normal<0.25<=Fine<0.5<=Superior<0.75<=Masterwork<0.9<=Legendary; efficacy_multiplier = 1 + diff/200 (reward_calculator.py:440-490, 81-104, 123-143, 34-40)

DIFFICULTY: base_points = sum(tier * quantity) per input, tier from MaterialDatabase with TIER_POINTS {1:1,2:2,3:3,4:4}, min 1.0; diversity_mult = 1 + (uniqueMaterials-1)*0.1; total = base * diversity (difficulty_calculator.py:130-175, 178-204, 642-648)

Difficulty -> wheel: linear interpolate over points 1..80: green_slices 12->6, red_slices 3->10; round then clamp green [4,14], red [2,12]; grey = 20-green-red with min 2 (excess removed from whichever of green/red is larger); spin_count fixed 3 (difficulty_calculator.py:609-671, 253-283, 56-59)
Difficulty tier names by points: common 0-4, uncommon 5-10, rare 11-20, epic 21-40, legendary 41+ (difficulty_calculator.py:47-53, 754-772)
Legacy fallback (only on ImportError of difficulty calculator): stationTier-based green/red = 10/3, 8/5, 7/7, 5/9 for T1-T4; points = tier*15 (enchanting.py:123-147)

APPLICATION (craft_with_minigame): input rarity from uniformity check (all input materials must share one rarity; missing materials default 'common'; debug mode forces 'common') (enchanting.py:1284-1288; rarity_utils.py:82-112)

base_bonus = max(5, int(difficulty_points/3)); rarity multipliers {common 1.0, uncommon 1.1, rare 1.2, epic 1.35, legendary 2.0}; final_bonus = int(base_bonus * rarity_mult * (1+efficacy)) — stored in enchantment_data.bonus_magnitude for the result payload only (enchanting.py:1313-1346)

Target-item path: target_item.apply_enchantment(enchantmentId, enchantmentName, recipe['effect']) — the recipe effect dict is applied VERBATIM, efficacy does not scale it; on apply failure returns success=False with reason (enchanting.py:1348-1375)

No-target path (accessory): returns success with outputId = enchantmentId, quantity 1; engine adds it to inventory via add_crafted_item_to_inventory (enchanting.py:1376-1389; game_engine.py:9062-9083)

EquipmentItem.apply_enchantment rules, in order: (1) reject exact duplicate enchantment_id; (2) parse family/tier by rsplit('_',1) with numeric suffix (else tier 1); (3) reject if same family with HIGHER tier already applied; (4) remove existing enchantments listed in new effect.conflictsWith OR whose own effect.conflictsWith contains the new id (bidirectional purge — this is how lower tiers of the same family get replaced); (5) append {enchantment_id, name, effect[, metadata_tags]} (equipment.py:251-310)
can_apply_enchantment: if recipe tags present use EnchantingTagProcessor.can_apply_to_item(tags, itemType); else legacy applicableTo list vs item type; no rules at all -> allow (equipment.py:215-249)

Item type detection: explicit item_type field (shield mapped to armor) else slot-based — mainHand/offHand with damage != (0,0) => weapon, without damage => tool; tool slot => tool; helmet/chestplate/leggings/boots/gauntlets => armor; else accessory (equipment.py:312-336)

ENGINE COMPLETION (_complete_minigame): builds inventory snapshot dict; debug infinite-resources injects 999999 per input and sets rarity_system.debug_mode; passes stored target item for adornments (game_engine.py:8890-8920)

On success: RecipeDatabase.consume_materials consumes 100% of recipe inputs from real inventory; record_activity('enchanting'); publish ITEM_CRAFTED event; stat_tracker.record_crafting; XP = int(20 * stationTier * 1.5); title + skill-unlock checks; crafting buffs consumed for category 'enchanting' (game_engine.py:8970-9045, 9033-9037, 9102-9106)
If result contains 'enchanted_item': no inventory add — notification + stat_tracker.record_enchantment_applied + clear stored target selection (game_engine.py:9047-9061)

Failure path exists for API parity (partial material loss 30-90% scaled by difficulty via consume_materials_partial) but is unreachable for the wheel since it always succeeds (game_engine.py:8934-8951; reward_calculator.py:497-519; enchanting.py:1296-1304)

Buff/title bonus plumbing: engine computes time/quality bonuses (quicken/empower/elevate/pierce buffs with category 'enchanting'; enchantingTime/enchantingQuality titles) and passes them into create_minigame, but SpinningWheelMinigame stores and never reads them — zero gameplay effect (game_engine.py:4220-4272; enchanting.py:63-66)
INT stat minigame-difficulty reduction explicitly excludes adornments — no adornments branch in the INT modifier block (game_engine.py:4303-4390)

Recipe loading: EnchantingCrafter loads recipes from recipes-enchanting-1.json then recipes-adornments-1.json (multi-path fallback), keyed by recipeId; placements loaded from placements-adornments-1.JSON keyed by recipeId (used only by dead pattern minigame) (enchanting.py:1082-1146)
data: recipes.JSON/recipes-adornments-1.json — 25 recipes; fields: recipeId ('enchanting_sharpness_basic'), enchantmentId ('sharpness_1'), enchantmentName ('Sharpness I'), applicableTo (['weapon']), stationTier (1), stationType ('enchanting'), inputs [{materialId:'fire_crystal', quantity:4}, ...], miniGame {type:'enchanting', difficulty:'easy', baseTime:30 — unused}, effect {type:'damage_multiplier', value:0.1, stackable:false, conflictsWith:['sharpness_2','sharpness_3']}, metadata.tags (['weapon','damage','basic']) (recipes-adornments-1.json:8-57)
recipes.JSON/recipes-enchanting-1.json — alternate filename tried first, same schema (enchanting.py:1088-1097)

placements.JSON/placements-adornments-1.JSON — placements[].{recipeId, placementMap{gridType:'square_8x8', vertices:{'x,y':{materialId,isKey}}, shapes:[{type,vertices,rotation}]}} — loaded but consumed only by the dead PatternMatchingMinigame (enchanting.py:1115-1146, 445-489)
MaterialDatabase — material.tier lookup per input materialId for difficulty points (default tier 1 if missing) (difficulty_calculator.py:150-173)
rarity_utils material_rarities map — materialId -> rarity string for the uniformity check; unknown -> 'common' (rarity_utils.py:102-112)

RecipeDatabase Recipe model — is_enchantment=True when raw JSON has 'enchantmentId'; output_id set to enchantmentId, output_qty forced 1; enchantment_name/applicable_to/effect copied (recipe_db.py:48-90; recipes.py:20-23)
stats-calculations.JSON intelligence config — read for other disciplines' INT reduction; not applied to adornments (game_engine.py:4308-4311)
constants: Wheel: 20 slices, 18 deg each, pointer offset +9 deg (slice center) (enchanting.py:241-244, 11295)
Payout multipliers [green, grey, red]: spin1 [1.2, 1.0, 0.66], spin2 [1.5, 0.95, 0.5], spin3 [2.0, 0.8, 0.0] (enchanting.py:90-94)
Spin animation: 2000 ms, ease-out cubic 1-(1-p)^3, 5 full rotations + final angle (enchanting.py:231-244)
Per-spin wheel decay: -spinNum green / +spinNum red; floors/caps green>=3, red<=12, green+red<=17 (enchanting.py:180-191)
First-try bonus: +0.10 performance for enchanting, capped at 1.0; applied when attempt==1 (reward_calculator.py:52-74; enchanting.py:373-375)
Difficulty points: tier*quantity linear (T1..T4 = 1..4 pts/item); diversity 1+(unique-1)*0.1; interpolation range 1..80 points (difficulty_calculator.py:35-40, 56-59, 182, 648)
Wheel distribution interpolation: green 12->6, red 3->10 (easy->hard); clamps green [4,14], red [2,12], grey min 2 (difficulty_calculator.py:614-617, 654-666)
Difficulty tiers: common 0-4, uncommon 5-10, rare 11-20, epic 21-40, legendary 41-150 (difficulty_calculator.py:47-53)
Legacy fallback wheels (ImportError only): T1 10G/3R, T2 8G/5R, T3 7G/7R, T4 5G/9R; points = tier*15 (enchanting.py:130-147)

Applied-bonus math (informational): base_bonus = max(5, int(points/3)); rarity mult common 1.0 / uncommon 1.1 / rare 1.2 / epic 1.35 / legendary 2.0; final = int(base*rarityMult*(1+efficacy)) (enchanting.py:1315-1332)
Rewards: max_multiplier = 1.0 + normalized*1.5 (range 1.0-2.5); bonus_pct = int(perf*(maxMult-1)*20); quality tier cuts 0.25/0.50/0.75/0.90 (reward_calculator.py:28-40, 96-104, 143, 463-478)
XP on minigame completion: int(20 * stationTier * 1.5) (game_engine.py:9034)
Quick-bet buttons: 10, 25, 50, ALL; default bet min(10, currency); bet floor 1 (game_engine.py:11452, 11408, 2363)
Double-click window 500 ms; UI window 1000x700 right-aligned; metadata max_bonus display = 1 + points*0.025 (game_engine.py:2337, 11169-11171, 11185)
hazards: Three minigame classes exist in enchanting.py but create_minigame ONLY ever returns SpinningWheelMinigame — PatternMatchingMinigame (435-748) and freeform EnchantingMinigame (751-1060) are dead code, as is get_available_shapes_for_tier and the placements data; do not port their mechanics as live features (enchanting.py:1241-1262)

Contradictory docstrings: module header says minigame REQUIRED (line 7, 27) while craft_instant's docstring claims 'Enchanting does NOT have minigames' (1177-1179); the actual live path is minigame-required via the engine; craft_instant exists and works but the engine's non-minigame enchant path bypasses it entirely (game_engine.py:7178-7207)

Efficacy is largely cosmetic on the item: final_bonus/bonus_magnitude are computed but apply_enchantment receives only recipe['effect'] verbatim — a -50% efficacy run applies the identical effect as +50%; only the result message/payload differ. Preserve this bug/design as-is (enchanting.py:1331-1354; equipment.py:292-301)

buff_time_bonus / buff_quality_bonus params (skill buffs + enchantingTime/enchantingQuality titles) are stored and never read by the wheel — buffs are still CONSUMED on completion despite doing nothing (enchanting.py:63-66; game_engine.py:4220-4272, 9102-9106)
self.attempt is initialized to 1 and never incremented anywhere, so the +0.10 first-try performance bonus applies on EVERY run (enchanting.py:69, 373)

Difficulty calculator computes green_multiplier/red_multiplier (1.5->1.2 / 0.8->0.0) but the minigame ignores them in favor of the hardcoded per-spin table — porting the calculator values into payouts would change balance (difficulty_calculator.py:619-623 vs enchanting.py:90-94)
Spin animation timing uses wall-clock time.time(), not the dt parameter passed to update(); dt is ms elsewhere. A paused game still advances the spin (enchanting.py:226-231)
Result slice is chosen uniformly at spin start; the visible deceleration is pure presentation. Win probability = greenCount/20 regardless of shuffle (enchanting.py:294, 199-200)

Slice-count clamp order matters: round -> clamp green [4,14] and red [2,12] -> enforce grey>=2 by subtracting from the LARGER of green/red; then per-spin modifiers re-clamp with different floors (green>=3, red<=12, sum<=17) — replicate both layers exactly (difficulty_calculator.py:654-666; enchanting.py:183-191)

grey_slices from params uses dict.get fallback '20 - green - red' — harmless now but shows duck-typing reliance; minigame also uses getattr defaults (green 10 / red 3) if difficulty attrs missing (enchanting.py:118, 176-177)

Material consumption is the ENGINE's job (RecipeDatabase.consume_materials after success); craft_with_minigame deliberately does NOT deduct from the inv_dict it receives — double-consumption was a historical bug class here (enchanting.py:1293-1294; game_engine.py:8970-8973)

craft_with_minigame does NOT re-run can_craft or rarity-uniformity gating; can_craft (with uniformity check) gates earlier at recipe-craft time. Mixed-rarity inputs are rejected up front with 'Mixed rarities' message (enchanting.py:1148-1172)

apply_enchantment tier-family logic keys off id suffix parsing ('sharpness_3' -> family 'sharpness', tier 3); ids without numeric suffix are family=id, tier 1. Lower tiers of a family are removed only via the conflictsWith purge, not the tier check — recipes must list conflicts for replacement to work (equipment.py:266-290)

The wheel path never passes metadata_tags to apply_enchantment (recipe metadata.tags unused for combat tagging on this path) and never fails, so the engine failure branch (partial loss, record failed craft) is dead for adornments (enchanting.py:1351-1354, 398-399)

Enchanting recipes are detected by presence of 'enchantmentId' in raw JSON; enchantmentId doubles as output_id and as the applied enchantment id — keep this dual role (recipe_db.py:50-56; enchanting.py:1207, 1335)

Target-item selection state (enchantment_selected_item {source_type, source_id, item_stack, equipment}) must survive from selection UI through minigame completion and be cleared after application; the equipment object is mutated in place, so equipped items gain the enchantment live (game_engine.py:7166-7171, 8918-8920, 9059-9061)

Two consume-path variants for non-minigame enchanting: _complete_enchantment_application does a test-apply on a deepcopy of enchantments, reverts, THEN consumes materials, then re-applies for real — preserves 'no materials lost on blocked enchant' guarantee (game_engine.py:7178-7200)
Betting slider stores screen-space rects each render frame for hit-testing next click — input handling depends on render having run (game_engine.py:11444-11498, 2356-2380)
Legacy _setup_difficulty_legacy triggers only on ImportError (never in normal runtime); include it or not knowingly — its numbers differ from the calculator path (enchanting.py:123-147)
